title: HUB → OOO child sub-workflow input
description: Payload passed by '[HUB] Bison Replies Dispatcher' (xPzdtWQiY3lGtqI1) to the OOO child workflows via executeWorkflowTrigger in passthrough mode. Derived by inspection of the live workflows on 2026-07-21: the HUB normalizes the raw Bison webhook body, and the children read the fields below. It is NOT a schema the HUB enforces today — nothing validates this boundary at runtime, which is why an unexpected shape fails deep inside a child rather than at the edge.

workspace_id.description: Bison workspace id. Joins to client_sequencers.external_workspace_id (TEXT since ADR-0012 — the workflow casts it with .toString()).

type.description: Bison event name. The HUB switches on this before calling a child.

tag.description: The tag whose attach/detach triggered the dispatch.

taggable_id.description: Bison lead id. Used as the Bison API path segment and, today, as the leads.external_id match key. Under ADR-0015 this becomes sequencer_contacts.external_contact_id, scoped by client_sequencer_id.

custom_variables.description: Bison per-lead custom fields. The workflow looks for name == 'gender' to derive the OOO routing category.
